body.name: Analytic branch and equality system
body.construction: Form all angular roots \(\partial_{\theta}\Pi_j=0\), angular multiple roots, angular endpoint transitions, reduced-factor projection endpoints, holdout stationary roots, multiple stationary roots, distinct-branch crossings, nontransverse crossings, candidate-value ties, flat-branch identities, and identical-branch identities on \(I\); retain every point, interval, and symbolic equality predicate generated by these systems.
